title: Selectable questions and steadier map interactions
body:
QUESTION CHAT
- Player questions, including pending and rejected submissions, remain text-selectable and can be copied with a button.
- Copy controls, success feedback, and manual-copy guidance are localized in English and Polish.

MAP INTERACTIONS
- World, regional, and US map tooltips stay anchored to the hovered feature instead of following the pointer.
- Regional and US map tiles continue updating during zooming for smoother visual feedback.
